location.zh: Brightway 公司，王經理辦公室

goal.en: Apologize to Ms. Wong for a serious mistake and explain how you will fix it.
goal.zh: 為嚴重的工作失誤向王經理道歉，並說明補救方式。

background: manager's office with a tidy wooden desk, two chairs facing it, a desk lamp, potted plant in the corner, glass wall facing an open-plan office, morning

intro.en: Tuesday morning. The lobby lights for Alpenhaus's newest hotel were supposed to arrive today. They didn't.
intro.zh: 星期二早上。阿爾彭豪斯飯店集團新飯店的大廳燈具今天應該送到，但沒有。

intro.en: Kai... Ms. Wong wants to see you. It's about the hotel order. Good luck.
intro.zh: 凱……王經理找你，是飯店訂單的事。祝你好運。

intro.en: Your stomach drops. You knock on her door.
intro.zh: 你的心一沉，敲了敲她的門。

lines.en: Sit down, Kai. The installation team went to the wrong address this morning. Do you know what happened?
lines.zh: 坐吧，凱。安裝團隊今天早上跑錯地址了。你知道是怎麼回事嗎？

choices.en: Yes. I typed in the wrong address. I take full responsibility.
choices.zh: 知道。是我輸入錯地址，我負全部責任。
choices.tip: I take full responsibility. 是正式場合承擔責任的標準說法，不推託、不找藉口。

choices.en: The system auto-filled it, so honestly, it's not really my fault.
choices.zh: 是系統自動帶入的，所以老實說不太算是我的錯。

lines.en: The system didn't press "send," Kai. You did.
lines.zh: 按下「送出」的不是系統，凱，是你。

story.en: Ms. Wong asks IT to check the system. The system is fine. Your credibility is not.
story.zh: 王經理請 IT 檢查系統。系統沒問題，你的信用卻出了問題。

fail.why: 出錯時先推給系統，會讓人覺得你在逃避。先認錯：It was my mistake. I take full responsibility.。

choices.en: Yes, it was my mistake. I am fully responsible to this problem.
choices.zh: 是的，是我的錯。這個問題我要負全責。

lines.en: Responsible TO the problem? You mean FOR it, I hope.
lines.zh: 對問題負責「to」？我希望你的意思是「for」。

story.en: Your apology starts with a grammar correction. Not the strong opening you needed this morning.
story.zh: 你的道歉從一次文法糾正開始。這可不是今天早上需要的開場。

fail.why: 「為某事負責」是 be responsible for something，to 後面接的是「對誰負責」。最穩的說法：I take full responsibility.。

lines.en: I appreciate the honesty. But the hotel opens on Friday, and they're very worried.
lines.zh: 謝謝你這麼坦白。但飯店星期五開幕，他們非常擔心。

choices.en: Here's how I'll fix it: the driver can redeliver by three today.
choices.zh: 我打算這樣補救：司機今天三點前可以重新送貨。
choices.tip: 道歉後馬上說 Here's how I'll fix it.，接上具體補救方案，主管最想聽的就是這個。

choices.en: I'm so sorry. I will think a method to make it up to the hotel.
choices.zh: 真的很抱歉，我會想辦法彌補飯店的。

lines.en: "Think a method"? I need an actual plan, Kai. Today.
lines.zh: Think a method？我需要的是實際的計畫，凱，今天就要。

story.en: You promise a method but have no method. The hotel manager calls Ms. Wong three times before lunch.
story.zh: 你承諾了辦法，卻沒有辦法。午餐前，飯店經理打了三通電話給王經理。

fail.why: 「想辦法」直譯 think a method 不自然，而且太模糊。要說出具體方案：Here's how I'll fix it: ...。

choices.en: I'm so sorry. If you want, I can hand in my resignation today.
choices.zh: 非常抱歉。如果您希望，我今天就可以遞辭呈。

lines.en: Resign? I need you to fix this, Kai, not disappear.
lines.zh: 辭職？凱，我需要你把事情處理好，不是消失。

story.en: Ms. Wong now has a lighting problem and an HR problem. Sam quietly hides your resignation letter in a drawer.
story.zh: 王經理現在除了燈具問題，又多了人事問題。山姆默默把你的辭呈藏進抽屜。

fail.why: 用辭職表達歉意，在英語職場常被看成逃避責任。主管要的是解決方案：Here's how I'll fix it.。

lines.en: Three o'clock. Good. And the hotel manager? Someone has to talk to them.
lines.zh: 三點，很好。那飯店經理呢？總得有人跟他們說明。

choices.en: I'd like to call the hotel myself and apologize directly.
choices.zh: 我想親自打給飯店，直接向他們道歉。
choices.tip: I'd like to... myself 表示主動承擔，親自向客戶道歉更有誠意。

choices.en: Could you call them instead? They'll listen to a manager more.
choices.zh: 可以請您打嗎？他們比較會聽經理的話。

lines.en: So I clean up, and you watch? That's not how this works.
lines.zh: 所以我收拾善後，你在旁邊看？不是這樣的。

story.en: Ms. Wong makes the call. You sit next to her, feeling very small, while she apologizes for your mistake.
story.zh: 王經理打了電話。你坐在旁邊，看著她為你的錯道歉，覺得自己好渺小。

fail.why: 把道歉推給主管，等於把責任再丟回去。主動說 I'd like to call them myself.，讓客戶知道負責的人在處理。

choices.en: I will call them myself right now and apologize them directly.
choices.zh: 我現在就親自打給他們，直接跟他們道歉。

lines.en: "Apologize them"? Please say it correctly on the phone, at least.
lines.zh: Apologize them？至少在電話裡要說對喔。

story.en: Ms. Wong makes you practice the call three times before letting you dial. The hotel waits a little longer.
story.zh: 王經理要你練習三次才准你撥號。飯店又多等了一會兒。

fail.why: apologize 是不及物動詞，要說 apologize to someone：apologize to them directly。

lines.en: Good. Now, how do we make sure this doesn't happen again?
lines.zh: 很好。那我們要怎麼確保這種事不再發生？

choices.en: From now on, I'll confirm every address with the client by email.
choices.zh: 從現在起，每個地址我都會用 email 跟客戶確認。
choices.tip: From now on, I'll... 說出具體的新做法，比空泛的「我會小心」更有說服力。

choices.en: I'll add one more checking step and be small heart every time.
choices.zh: 我會多加一道檢查，每次都會小心。

lines.en: Be... small heart? Kai, are you feeling okay?

story.en: Ms. Wong suggests you take the afternoon off. You spend it googling "small heart English meaning."
story.zh: 王經理建議你下午休息。你花了一整個下午搜尋 small heart 的英文意思。

fail.why: 「小心」不是 small heart，要說 be careful。不過主管更想聽具體做法：From now on, I'll confirm every address by email.。

choices.en: From now on, I will double-checking every address with the clients.
choices.zh: 從現在起，我會跟客戶再三確認每個地址。

lines.en: "Will double-checking"? Let's double-check that sentence first.
lines.zh: Will double-checking？我們先再檢查一次這個句子吧。

story.en: Ms. Wong writes your sentence on a sticky note and corrects it. You keep the note on your monitor for a month.
story.zh: 王經理把你的句子寫在便利貼上訂正。你把它貼在螢幕上整整一個月。

fail.why: will 後面接原形動詞：I will double-check。will + V-ing 只用在 will be + V-ing 的進行式。

lines.en: All right. Is there anything else you want to say?

choices.en: Only that I'm truly sorry for the trouble. It won't happen again.
choices.zh: 只想說，造成麻煩真的很抱歉。不會再發生了。
choices.tip: It won't happen again. 搭配前面的具體方案，承諾才有份量。

choices.en: Could you please not tell the team about this? I'd lose so much face.
choices.zh: 可以請您別跟團隊說這件事嗎？我會很沒面子。

lines.en: This isn't about your face, Kai. It's about the client.
lines.zh: 凱，這跟你的面子無關，重點是客戶。

story.en: Ms. Wong doesn't tell the team. She doesn't have to. Your request already told her everything about your priorities.
story.zh: 王經理沒跟團隊說，也不需要說。你的請求已經讓她看清你在乎什麼。

fail.why: 道歉時擔心自己的面子，會讓人覺得你把形象放在客戶之前。把焦點放在對方：I'm truly sorry for the trouble.。

choices.en: No. I already said sorry twice, so I think we're done here, right?
choices.zh: 沒有。我已經道歉兩次了，所以應該可以了吧？

lines.en: We're done when I say we're done, Kai.
lines.zh: 什麼時候結束，由我決定，凱。

story.en: Two good apologies, ruined by one sentence. The meeting goes on for another thirty very long minutes.
story.zh: 兩次漂亮的道歉，被一句話毀了。會議又延長了漫長的三十分鐘。

fail.why: 道歉的最後一句決定對方的印象，不耐煩會抵銷前面的誠意。用承諾收尾：It won't happen again.。

lines.en: At 2:40, the truck pulls up at the hotel. The lobby lights go up with time to spare.
lines.zh: 兩點四十分，貨車開到飯店門口。大廳燈具在時限前裝好了。

lines.en: Good recovery, Kai. Everyone makes mistakes. People remember how you handle them.
lines.zh: 補救得很好，凱。每個人都會犯錯，大家記得的是你怎麼處理。

story.en: You admitted the mistake, fixed it, and made a plan so it won't happen again. Ms. Wong will remember that much longer than the wrong address.
story.zh: 你承認錯誤、補救問題，還訂出防止再犯的方法。比起寫錯的地址，王經理會記得更久的是這些。

notes.explain: 正式道歉時承擔責任的說法。比 It's my fault. 更正式，適合對主管或客戶使用。

example.en: The delay was my mistake, and I take full responsibility.
example.zh: 延誤是我的錯，我負全部責任。

notes.explain: 道歉之後立刻提出具體方案。英語職場重視「認錯＋解決」，只道歉不提方案會顯得被動。

example.en: I'm sorry about the error. Here's how I'll fix it: I'll resend the files tonight.
example.zh: 抱歉出了錯。我打算這樣補救：今晚重新寄檔案。

notes.explain: 搭配 From now on, I'll... 的具體做法一起說，承諾才可信。只說這句沒有做法，會顯得空洞。

example.en: From now on, I'll check twice. It won't happen again.
example.zh: 從現在起我會檢查兩次，不會再發生了。

notes.en: apologize to someone / responsible for something
notes.zh: 向某人道歉／為某事負責
notes.explain: apologize 不能直接接人，要說 apologize to them。「為某事負責」用 responsible for，不是 responsible to。

example.en: I apologized to the client for the delay.

notes.en: Own it, fix it, move on.
notes.explain: 英語職場不期待你用辭職或過度自責謝罪，也不欣賞推卸。坦白認錯、提出方案、說明預防方法，就是最專業的道歉。

example.en: I made a mistake, I fixed it, and I learned from it.
example.zh: 我犯了錯，補救了，也從中學到教訓。
